changelog: Backtest realism, part 2 fixes — a fix release for v3.22.1's own bugs, found by actually running it in a real browser (headless Chromium), not new scope.

Fix 1 (real calc bug, gate 5): Keep 3R wasn't recomputing TP when the effective entry changed — switching a ticket from Limit to Market moved the entry used everywhere else, but TP stayed put, so a '3R' take-profit silently stopped being 3R. Centralized into two new functions, btTicketEffectiveEntry()/btTicketApplyKeep3R(), called from every path that can move effective entry, stop, or direction while Keep 3R is checked: ticket open, the orderType toggle, the direction toggle, and every stop-loss change (typed or dragged).

Fix 2: the sidebar's 'Open Ticket' wrongly refused with 'Stop loss is required.' when its own SL field was empty. Renamed 'New Trade', always opens the ticket now, prefilled from the selected position tool, else the most recent not-yet-linked position drawing, else a bare Market ticket at the current close. All validation moved into the ticket's own disabled-button reason (a new explicit 'Enter a stop loss.' check); the sidebar's own SL/TP/Limit-price inputs are removed entirely.

Fix 3: while a ticket is open, the drawing it was opened from now renders its box/pills from the ticket's own live values (entry/SL/TP/risk/size) instead of its last-saved settings, so the chart and the ticket can never show two different trades. Cancel needs no revert logic — d.settings is never touched while the ticket is open. A ticket opened with no source drawing renders a temporary box from the ticket's values instead. Place Trade now saves the ticket's final values into the source drawing via the existing btUpdateDrawing().

Fix 4: the floating selection toolbar was positioned from the entry/stop/TP LINE positions, but the Stop/Target pills are drawn offset outside their line — so the toolbar sat on top of the Target pill (Long) or Stop pill (Short). Now measures from the pills' own actual bounding box (d._btPillBounds), and flips below the lowest pill if placing it above would leave the chart area.
Fix 5: a one-line sidebar hint ('Draw a Long/Short position on the chart, or click New Trade.') now shows whenever the session has no position-tool drawing at all.

Also fixed, found while building the new browser test harness (not one of the original five): clicking anywhere inside the order ticket or the floating toolbar was silently deselecting the linked drawing and hiding the toolbar — both widgets live inside .tv-chart-wrap, which the drawing tools' own capture-phase mousedown/dblclick/contextmenu listeners also watch, and a click that didn't hit a drawing on the canvas was treated as 'clicked empty chart space, deselect.' Fixed with one guard (btEventIsOnDrawingSurface()) checked first in all three handlers.

New tools/ui-harness/ — a reusable, DB-free Playwright+PHP harness (outside app/, never deployed, not in this files list) that stubs config.php/api.php, vendors the two chart-library CDN scripts locally, serves a temp copy of app/ via php -S, and drives it with real Chromium, asserting on live page state and saving a screenshot after every step. Use this for every UI release in this project from now on.
release_notes: No schema changes -- pure JS/PHP-view fixes, no migration. Verified end-to-end in a real browser via the new tools/ui-harness/ (see CLAUDE.md's v3.22.2 section): Fix 1's exact repro (TP recomputes correctly, RR 1:3.00, submitted payload matches), Fix 2 (New Trade opens empty-SL on Market, disabled reason, enables once SL is typed), Fix 3 (pill sync during Limit->Market switch, Cancel reverts, Place Trade saves into the drawing), Fix 4 (zero toolbar/pill overlap for both Long and Short, verified by pixel-rectangle overlap, not just screenshots), Fix 5 (hint shows/hides with drawing count). php -l and node --check clean on every changed file.
